name: Stone statue
description: A weathered stone statue of a robed, hooded figure about 1.9 m tall, hands folded on the pommel of a point-down sword, on a square dressed-stone plinth 0.9 m wide and 0.5 m high with a moulded top edge. Worn grey-brown stone, simple robe folds, no face detail, a little moss at the plinth base.
